result.reason: The operative language makes the cap mutual and agreement-wide, sets it at the preferred greater-of 12 months’ paid/payable fees or US$1 million, includes all preferred uncapped carve-outs, and excludes Client payment obligations from damages. It therefore exceeds the stated fallback and substantially reaches the preferred position. The unchanged indemnity preserves unrelated commercial terms, and the revisions are targeted and professionally drafted. However, it omits the preferred mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages and could more precisely state that the fee lookback precedes the claim.
